contextReview.basis: Direct review: overcast daytime East Asian urban streets with small tiled building walls, shop windows, canvas awnings, potted plants, parked scooters and brick or stone paving; no rain depicted and reflective paving is not read as rain; white reflective details catch the direct flash; humidity not inferred. Mixed adult model casting is independent of the location.

casting.castingPolicy: mixed adult model appearance independent of the East Asian urban location (user 2026-11-03)

approval.evidence: Five editorials passed producer QA and continued under the user's standing workflow authorization (2026-11-03, "앞으로도 승인 없이 진행"); the user did not visually approve them individually. Product images passed producer technical QA and producer visual QA on four backgrounds only.

reconstructionNotice: No hand-held prop; the tiled wall, awning and street are the setting. The vest closes with exactly two chest buckles and has no zip. The hands cover part of the upper buckle, and the vest back and hidden mesh are inferred. The sage long sleeve is a separate product beneath the vest. The watch is a silver round case on a black flexible strap, not a metal bracelet; its hidden strap length is inferred. The black ankle pants' waist is partly hidden. Brand, metal, fibre composition, performance and retail identity are unknown.

intro.ko: 조금 움직인 베스트를 바로잡으려고 두 가슴끈을 잡습니다.

body.ko: 지퍼 없는 베스트의 두 버클과 옆 수납 패널이 세이지 상의와 분리되어 읽힙니다. 검정 발목 팬츠의 흰 종아리 패치가 상의의 짧은 반사선과 이어지고 흰 러닝화가 하체 끝을 밝힙니다. 은색 케이스와 검정 밴드의 시계가 손목에 놓입니다.
body.en: Two buckles and side storage panels on the zip-free vest remain distinct from the sage top. White calf patches on black ankle pants echo the short upper-arm lines, with white runners finishing below. A silver-tone case and black watch strap sit at the wrist.
body.de: Zwei Schnallen und seitliche Taschen der Weste ohne Zip bleiben vom Salbeishirt getrennt. Weiße Wadenflächen an schwarzen Knöchelhosen greifen die kurzen Oberarmlinien auf, weiße Laufschuhe schließen ab. Silberfarbenes Uhrengehäuse und schwarzes Band liegen am Handgelenk.
